program:
PARAMS = {
    "Ip":    (55e-6, 40e-6, 66e-6),   # PMOS gain-device current (sets power)
    "gmidp": (15.0, 10.0, 19.0),      # PMOS gm/Id
    "Lp":    (0.25, 0.15, 0.6),       # PMOS length
    "Ln":    (0.18, 0.15, 0.5),       # NMOS length
    "A_t":   (11.5, 9.5, 14.0),       # target |gain|, sets R
    "dvo":   (0.0, -0.1, 0.1),        # offset of vout from swing center
    "kcb":   (25.0, 10.0, 50.0),      # CB / (PMOS gate load incl. Miller)
}

def _solve_w(lut, dev, L, vgs, vds, I, vsb=0.0):
    W = 5.0
    for _ in range(12):
        o = lut.op(dev, W, L, vgs, vds, vsb)
        W = min(max(W * I / max(o["Id"], 1e-12), 0.42), 3000.0)
    return W, lut.op(dev, W, L, vgs, vds, vsb)

def _size_p(lut, gmid, L, I, vds):
    g = gmid
    mp = lut.size("p", g, L, I, vds=vds)
    while mp.W > 2500.0 and g > 6.0:
        g -= 0.5
        mp = lut.size("p", g, L, I, vds=vds)
    return mp

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vin = spec.get("vin_dc", spec.get("vcm", 0.75))
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    Ip, Ln, Lp, A_t = p["Ip"], p["Ln"], p["Lp"], p["A_t"]

    vo = 0.92
    R = 12e3
    for _ in range(4):
        In = max(Ip - (vo - vin) / R, 0.3 * Ip)
        Wn, on = _solve_w(lut, "n", Ln, vin, vo, In)
        mp = _size_p(lut, p["gmidp"], Lp, Ip, vdd - vo)
        gm = on["gm"] + mp.gm
        G = on["gds"] + mp.gds
        den = max(gm - A_t * G, 0.25 * gm)
        R = (A_t + 1.0) / den
        vdn = max(on.get("vdsat", 0.12), 0.05)
        vdp = max(mp.vdsat, 0.05)
        vo = 0.5 * (vdn + vdd - vdp) + p["dvo"]
        vo = min(max(vo, 0.5), 1.3)

    In = max(Ip - (vo - vin) / R, 0.3 * Ip)
    Wn, on = _solve_w(lut, "n", Ln, vin, vo, In)
    mp = _size_p(lut, p["gmidp"], Lp, Ip, vdd - vo)
    gm = on["gm"] + mp.gm
    G = on["gds"] + mp.gds

    # PMOS gate level: ibias = vin + iref*RS
    vshift = max(vdd - mp.vgs - vin, 0.05)
    RS = vshift / iref

    dn = lut.size("n", min(max(on["gm_id"], 3.0), 24.0), Ln, In, vds=vo)
    ctot = cl + dn.cdd + mp.cdd + dn.cgd + mp.cgd

    gout = 1.0 / R + G
    A = (gm - 1.0 / R) / gout

    cgate = mp.cgg + mp.cgd * (A + 1.0)
    CB = min(max(p["kcb"] * cgate, 5e-12), 40e-12)
    kc = CB / (CB + cgate)
    gm_hf = on["gm"] + kc * mp.gm
    A_mid = (gm_hf - 1.0 / R) / gout

    f3db = gout / (2 * PI * ctot)
    gbw = A_mid * f3db

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.M("MN", "vout", "vin", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wn, Ln)
    n.dev("MP", "vout", "ibias", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.R("RS", "ibias", "vin", RS)
    n.C("CB", "ibias", "vin", CB)
    n.R("RL", "vout", "vin", R)

    vdn = max(on.get("vdsat", 0.12), 0.05)
    vdp = max(mp.vdsat, 0.05)
    swing = 2.0 * min(vo - vdn, vdd - vdp - vo)
    power = vdd * (Ip + iref)
    return n, {
        "gain_db": db(A),
        "f3db": f3db,
        "gbw": gbw,
        "power": power,
        "vout_dc": vo,
        "swing": swing,
    }

events.topology: complementary (inverter) CS with resistive load R from vout to vin

events.reason: Program rejected because the word 'input' appears in comments (forbidden token). Removing it; topology and budget otherwise reasonable (99 uW, ~1.1 mS gm vs 754 uS needed for 240 MHz GBW).
Swing limited by PMOS strong inversion (Vsg=1.05). Add PMOS source-follower level shift biased by IREF to drive PMOS gate ~0.45V higher -> moderate inversion, small Vdsat, keeps PMOS gm in path.

Follower mis-set PMOS gate (PMOS ~off, vout 0.34 V). Replace with exact level shift: IREF through RS (ibias->vin, bypassed by CB) so PMOS Vsg is set by design. Push-pull gm_n+gm_p, R to vin for gain/D
Mid-band droop: RS(~50k) with CB=2pF vs PMOS Cgg+Miller Cgd forms a gate-coupling pole at ~1MHz, losing PMOS gm (f3db 1.1MHz, ugbw 118MHz). Size CB to 25x gate load incl. Miller so the coupling ratio
Topology and DC point are sound: gain, swing and vout pass. GBW (gm/Ctot) is 30% short, and f3db follows from it. Gain has 2 dB margin and there is ~45 uW of power headroom. Push Ip toward the budget
Refiner pushed PMOS to deep weak inversion (W=61 mm). Added a guard that lowers gm/Id until W<=2500 um, tightened gmidp/Lp bounds, and capped CB. Topology is unchanged.

Only swing misses (1.492 vs 1.5 V) while gain, f3db and GBW have ample margin. Raise PMOS gm/Id to cut Vdsat, cut target gain to flatten the transfer curve, and let the refiner trim dvo and Ip to cent
